source: Table C-18, p.C-87; Tables C-23 and C-24, pp.C-93 to C-95; C.7.1.2, pp.C-95 to C-96; C.4.10, pp.C-43 to C-45
description: A MANAGEMENT D_PDU received on a link puts the peer in MANAGEMENT(CONNECTED): the acknowledgement owed for data and the client's ARQ data wait for the management acknowledgement, then follow it in the same transmission as one DATA-ACK.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with an Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST, our accept goes out at 52000, and when that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made with the 16-bit family (B-0213, B-0142) and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 runs (B-0215). D_CONNECTION_MADE starts the expedited ARQ machine afresh as well (C-0755). The peer is recorded Ed4, so spare room in a last block takes a PADDING D_PDU when it fits (C-0367, C-1154). At 61000 the peer's burst holds a MANAGEMENT (type 6) D_PDU with VALID MESSAGE set, frame ID 0, no extended message and EOW 0, then a DATA-ONLY, FSN 0, 'ping' from SAP 5 (EOT 20 on both). The type 6 is a new message (frame ID 0 differs from the initial RX MANAGEMENT FRAME ID, C-0310, C-0314, C-0315): IDLE(CONNECTED) goes to MANAGEMENT(CONNECTED) (C-0664) and an acknowledgement is owed (C-0296). The DATA-ONLY is processed in MANAGEMENT(CONNECTED) (C-0718): delivered (cas.first_data stops, S_UNIDATA_INDICATION to conn 1), and an ACK-ONLY composed to send later, since MANAGEMENT(CONNECTED) sends only types 6, 8, 13, 14 and 15 (C-0748, C-1215). At 61500 the client sends an S_UNIDATA_REQUEST to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3 ('pong', TTD 1296061500): an ARQ request in MANAGEMENT(CONNECTED) is queued until the management exchange is over (C-0713, C-0737), and dts.ttd starts. At 83000 the MANAGEMENT acknowledgement goes first (C-0297, C-1041): ACK set, VALID MESSAGE clear, frame ID 0 echoed (C-0302, C-1073), 13 bytes, EOT 20. Placing it ends the management exchange (C-1070, read for the CONNECTED half), so the node goes to DATA(CONNECTED) (C-0738, C-1213), and the deferred acknowledgement and the released data follow in the same transmission (C-1129, C-1215) as one DATA-ACK (C-0238, C-1128): FSN 0, C_PDU START and END, DELIVER IN ORDER, both TX WIN flags, RX LWE 1, bitmap encoding, no Selective Acks, 'pong'; 32 bytes, EOT 20. 45 bytes in 2 blocks; the 5 left take no copy and no PADDING. At 93350 dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts; at 101000 the peer's ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 acknowledges FSN 0: dts.ack_wait stops, the C_PDU is confirmed and dts.ttd is cancelled. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20 for 1, 2 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so an EXPEDITED-DATA-ONLY is 18 bytes plus its segment, an EXPEDITED-ACK-ONLY 12 bytes plus its bitmap, a MANAGEMENT D_PDU with no extended bytes 13, a WARNING 12, a PADDING 11, a DATA-ONLY 19 bytes plus its segment and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080).
